title: Italian-Style Potato Skillet
description: A hearty, Italian-inspired potato skillet recipe, perfect for a weeknight dinner. With crispy potatoes, savory flavors, and a hint of Italian spices.
instructions: Heat the Spanish Olive Oil in the Skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced Potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the Salt, Black Pepper, and Italian Seasoning to the Potatoes and stir to combine.
Continue cooking the Potatoes for another 10-12 minutes, or until they're tender and golden brown.
Remove the Skillet from the heat and stir in the Warm Water.
Serve the Italian-Style Potato Skillet hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
